question.html:
A uniform solid disc and a uniform solid sphere of the same density roll down the same inclined plane without slipping. The disc and the sphere have the same mass and roll through the same distance. 

What is true about the rotational kinetic energy and the total kinetic energy of the objects?

Rotational kinetic energy

Total kinetic energy
A. different same
B. same different
C. same same
D. different different
